info.name: Tamagotchi
info.description:
A scenario of the Tamagotchi service through the Gateway, with real User Management accounts and tokens. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: every request feeds the next.

Setup finds the active package in Registry, registers and logs in two fresh users, and fetches a Battle service token. Each registration publishes user.package_joined.v1, and Tamagotchi mints the package starter from it, so the creatures are polled for rather than minted: no service is allowed tamagotchi:mint.

Needs the shared stack with the broker, a seeded Registry, Tamagotchi with USER_MANAGEMENT_URL and PACKAGE_REGISTRY_URL set, and battle_service_secret set as a current value to BATTLE_SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRET from deploy/.env. Never save that value in the collection. Care expectations follow the seeded Dragon Tamers rules: feed adds 20 hunger, capped at 100, and 5 xp.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script because Postman's {{$guid}} is v4 and the contract rejects it.
